title: Validate every ERP requirement clause before comparison
prompt: Change satisfies() to validate every clause before returning the conjunction. An early false clause currently hides invalid later syntax; malformed constraints must always raise controlled ValueError. Offline source and regression tests only; preserve existing authority boundaries. Verify: False-first plus invalid-later constraints raise ValueError; valid false/true multi-clause cases retain results; caller manifest remains unchanged
acceptance: False-first plus invalid-later constraints raise ValueError
valid false/true multi-clause cases retain results

title: Bound ERP version and requirement parsing
prompt: Limit version strings to 64 characters and numeric components to 9 digits; limit requirements to 1024 characters and 32 clauses. Reject excess through ValueError before integer conversion or unbounded iteration. Offline source and regression tests only; preserve existing authority boundaries. Verify: Exact boundaries and one-over cases are tested; pinned v15/v16 manifest still passes; oversized digits produce controlled errors
acceptance: Exact boundaries and one-over cases are tested

title: Expose mapping-specific diagnostic reasons
prompt: Add mapping_reason_codes and max_mapping_age_seconds to read_snapshot. Report mapping_unavailable, mapping_stale or mapping_clock_skew independently of receipt/capture reasons; recent mapping has an empty mapping reason list. Keep absence_ready false. Offline source and regression tests only; preserve existing authority boundaries. Verify: Unavailable/recent/stale/skew projections have stable reasons; old mapping with recent capture retains warning; threshold equality stays recent
acceptance: old mapping with recent capture retains warning

title: Fingerprint validated aggregate snapshots
prompt: Expose snapshot_sha256 as SHA-256 of exact bounded file bytes only after complete validation; null otherwise. This is a change detector, never source authenticity or attendance coverage evidence. Offline source and regression tests only; preserve existing authority boundaries. Verify: Same valid bytes yield same digest; changed valid bytes yield a different digest; invalid/oversized input yields no digest or raw content
acceptance: Same valid bytes yield same digest
changed valid bytes yield a different digest
invalid/oversized input yields no digest or raw content

title: Validate the snapshot evaluation clock explicitly
prompt: Validate supplied now before formatting/subtracting: accept only timezone-aware datetime, normalize to UTC, and raise controlled ValueError for invalid caller clocks. Missing now remains current UTC; malformed file handling remains unchanged. Offline source and regression tests only; preserve existing authority boundaries. Verify: Naive/non-datetime clocks raise ValueError; equivalent timezone offsets yield equal ages; UTC reads and unavailable-file output retain compatibility
acceptance: equivalent timezone offsets yield equal ages
UTC reads and unavailable-file output retain compatibility

title: Validate the allowed route catalogue before selection
prompt: Add shared catalogue validation: nonempty list/tuple/set/frozenset of unique nonempty string IDs, at most 64 IDs of at most 128 characters. normalize_choice returns None for invalid catalogues; select_route raises ValueError. Preserve valid behavior. Offline source and regression tests only; preserve existing authority boundaries. Verify: String/generator/duplicate/unhashable catalogues reject deterministically; size boundaries tested; valid routes and authority denial remain unchanged
acceptance: valid routes and authority denial remain unchanged

title: Require explicit boolean routing trust flags
prompt: Require calibrated is True before evaluating a decision so truthy strings/integers cannot activate calibrated selection. Require evaluator in_domain supplied to normalize_choice to be actual bool, otherwise return None. Jev remains disabled. Offline source and regression tests only; preserve existing authority boundaries. Verify: calibrated string/1 uses deterministic fallback; invalid in_domain yields None; true booleans preserve existing behavior

title: Reject non-object policy metadata consistently
prompt: Only missing/None metadata defaults to empty; reject falsey/truthy non-dict request metadata and key_metadata with stable Denied reasons before reservation. Preserve unknown administrator metadata keys for LiteLLM compatibility. Offline source and regression tests only; preserve existing authority boundaries. Verify: Lists/bool/zero/strings reject for both metadata sources; None/empty dict retain defaults; denial creates no debit
acceptance: Lists/bool/zero/strings reject for both metadata sources
